form.p: Fills this database with a complete cloud seeding operator:

ul.li: three clients in the United Arab Emirates, Malaysia, and Norway, with six target areas and an active contract each;
HF-1000 flares in five batches, a vendor, and a reorder rule per base;
25 past missions, flown through the readiness checks, with their flare releases, client summaries to review, and the invoices of past months;
six weather snapshots recorded from Open-Meteo, and observed rainfall for missions flown more than two weeks ago (fetched from the reanalysis archive while loading, if it can be reached).

form.p: The company is renamed Stratus Ridge Weather Services. Dates are set relative to today.
